THE ARCHIVE 1a — PENTHOUSE CAPSTONE COLLISIONS + the blackmail exit that went nowhere. ROOT CAUSE: cap_first_penthouse_service ('The arrangement', 5_scenes:16) is pri 11 — the highest of the three penthouse auto-fires — and was gated ONLY on opening_done is_true + mercer_hub_open is_false. It knew nothing about story progress, so whenever the hub had never been opened it out-ranked whichever capstone actually owned the moment. Measured via setup.selectAutoFireCanvasForLocation('penthouse'): docs-in-hand + hub-never-opened -> cap_first_penthouse_service instead of cap_1a_close (pri 9); mid-repair + hub-never-opened -> cap_first_penthouse_service instead of salvage_mercer_shocked (pri 8, which additionally REQUIRED mercer_hub_open is_true so it literally could not fire). FIXED, 4 edits, two deliberately different shapes: (1) cap_first_penthouse_service gains a STATE guard, docs_retrieved is_false — not a priority bump, because a priority race is what caused the bug. Suppresses nothing of value: the penthouse seals the moment the close runs. (2) 6_dev_shortcuts dev_jump_archive_start now seeds mercer_hub_open (it set 14 flags but not this one; by Archive-start Wren has served Mercer all game, so the jump was lying about the state it claims to land you in). NOT a teleport: vance_securities is 'an internal division high in Vance Tower', penthouse is 'the top floor' — one elevator ride, and cross-location exits are the house pattern (salvage_mercer_shocked -> the_waterfront, react_calloway_precover -> spire_plaza, cap_1a_close -> the_waterfront). This is the ONE place an ordering is load-bearing, and it's safe because the capstones are state-exclusive: mid-repair means salvage_done is_false, while cap_1a_close needs docs_retrieved is_true, which can't precede salvage_relaunched (required by vance_securities' own entry_conditions).
